answer: Tie admission to renewable-data stewardship. Each identity adopts one randomly assigned public dataset shard for ten epochs, posts a 25-POA bond, and publishes a weekly error patch plus reproducible test. A forge committee of seven accepts a patch only if five rerun it; a zephyr beacon rotates shards, preventing prepared copies. The ledger marks each valid shard as a lotus claim that cannot fund another identity. N aliases need N distinct patches and lock 25N POA; duplicate work burns both bonds.
